scope: Upper Primary; official current published rules, not a prediction of 2027 questions

supports: current permitted pocket/scientific calculators for Upper Primary

sources.author: Australian Maths Trust, 2024 Upper Primary competition paper, bilingual edition

example_policy: Original illustrative teaching examples. Do not reproduce questions from the app's authentic exam bank.
app_claims: The signed-in lesson offers Read, Watch and Practise. Students can work on paper, enter final answers and record a first hint or help. In Test Centre practice, Part A counts up from zero and the goal is 20 correct answers in 20 minutes or less. Part B covers questions 21–30 with a 40-minute limit. Each submitted part provides a review report.
